messages:
sanjay: Heads-up: starting next sprint were standardizing the release window cadence to reduce mid-week firefights. Please read and flag blockers by EOD Wed.

kevin: quick q: why now?

sanjay: two reasons: 1) align with our major partner deploys (theyve moved to Tue/Thu) so we reduce cross-team contention; 2) improve observability by consolidating canaries into a single targeted slot.

maya: whats the new schedule?

sanjay: New schedule (trial for 3 sprints):
- Primary deploy: Tue 11:30-15:30 PT (no planned infra drains)
- Canary-only: Thu 09:30-12:00 PT (shorter, more metrics)
- Release freeze: Fri 20:00 PT -> Mon 07:00 PT
- Emergency hotpatch window: Sun 08:00-10:00 PT (sev1/2 only, must follow hotpatch playbook)

ops-oncall: Put a note in the rota. Weekend oncall will be on standby for Sunday hotpatch. If you book a hotpatch, prefix the message with HOTPATCH and include the runbook link.

release-bot: [automated] Updated cadence doc uploaded: https://go/redwood/releases/cadence-2026-v2

dana: A couple of constraints to call out:
- No non-critical schema migrations during Tue primary window. If you must, get approval from infra and DB team.
- Reserved/Dedicated pools: please do not schedule capacity reservations or scheduled node drains during Tue window.
- Feature rollout preference: server-side flags + phased exposure.

oliver: any impact on staging or perf envs?

sanjay: Staging cutover will move to Tue 06:30 PT for a longer soak. Perf envs unaffected but avoid heavy load tests during Tue-Thu windows.

maya: QA signoff process?

kevin: QA ops: well require a green smoke test run in canary (Thu) and signoff in the release board before Tue primary. Leaving time for rollback if needed.

ops-oncall: Rollback tips: keep rollbacks as small as possible, prefer flag toggles. If rollback invoked, notify #eng-oncall + #eng-releases with root cause summary.

sanjay: Ill schedule a 20m sync Friday 09:00 PT to walk the checklist and update the release board tags: "Tue-primary-v2" and "Thu-canary-v2". Please add any cross-team migrations to that board before Thursday EOD.

dana: thanks. If no objections, this becomes the working cadence next sprint. :thumbsup:

kevin: noted, will update infra runbook and inform partners.

maya: adding a note for library teams: if your change touches serialization format, signal it now.

sanjay: exactly  thanks everyone. If you hit conflicts, post here or DM me directly.
